## Description
Scheduled **Full Regression** on main failed four canonical Playwright visual assertions at the same pinned SHA. This is a distinct cohort from #4231's staging promotion baseline drift; do not assume the same root cause or regenerate screenshots without visual review.

## Reproduction
- Run: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44904296414 (2026-11-21 12:31–12:46 UTC), event `schedule`, branch `main`, pinned SHA `cc2660f61bc6d5064a5c01ec9f1307a255675092`, attempt 1.
- Job `full` ID `136846554678`, step 14 `Run full canonical Playwright suite at pinned SHA` failed.
- Result: **511 passed, 4 failed** after retries:
  - `fixture-visual-app.spec.ts:487` App 390×844 / Files list
  - `fixture-visual-app.spec.ts:541` App 390×844 / Claude Code conversation
  - `fixture-visual.spec.ts:98` Web 1440×900 / Claude Code conversation
  - `fixture-visual.spec.ts:213` Web 1440×900 / Claude Code configuration
- Example explicit mismatch: `web-claude-code-view-tabs-configuration-linux.png` expected **380×32**, actual **426×32**, 657 differing pixels (5%); persisted through retry 2.
- Artifact: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44904296414/artifacts/14707472405 (Playwright report, screenshots, traces, candidate manifest); uploaded successfully. This is an unauthenticated failure candidate, not Acceptance Pass.

## Impact
Scheduled main Full Regression is red despite the remaining 511 passing cases. This is a deterministic observed **browser visual assertion mismatch**, not an evidenced runner, cache, network, or artifact-upload failure. Exact source of the layout change is **not yet established**.

## Location
- `web/src/app/fixture-visual-app.spec.ts` lines 487, 541
- `web/src/fixture-visual.spec.ts` lines 98, 213
- Affected viewports: App 390×844, Web 1440×900
- Affected fixtures: Files list, Claude Code conversation, Claude Code configuration

## Investigation Status
Exact source of the layout change is **not yet established**.

1. Compare expected/actual/diff and trace for all four cases; correlate main SHA with preceding passing Full Regression and relevant layout changes.
2. If UI behavior is unintended, repair the owning App/Web layout and verify both viewport sizes.
3. If intentional, obtain design-owner approval and regenerate only affected canonical PNGs and required manifest blob pins through the approved baseline workflow. Do not raise screenshot tolerance, skip assertions, or wholesale refresh.
4. Cross-reference #4231 (different staging drift), #3971, #3829 and #4222 before changing ownership; avoid duplicate fixes.

## Fix Direction
1. If UI behavior is unintended: repair the owning App/Web layout component and verify both viewport sizes.
2. If intentional layout change: obtain design-owner approval and regenerate only affected canonical PNGs and required manifest blob pins through the approved baseline workflow.
3. Do not raise screenshot tolerance, skip assertions, or wholesale refresh baselines.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01: All four mismatches are explained by exact expected/actual evidence and traced to the responsible change or approved baseline drift.
- [ ] SC-02: A narrow fix or approved baseline update passes the relevant fixture-visual tests at the exact PR HEAD, with manifest pins and positive/negative checks where applicable.
- [ ] SC-03: A new authenticated main Full Regression run on the repaired SHA passes; no visual gate is weakened.

## E2E Verification
### New
- none: no new E2E spec is introduced; reuse the existing canonical fixture-visual suites
### Regression
- fixture-visual-app
- fixture-visual

- Decision: Read

- Owner and timing: implementing owner before changing snapshots

## Product alignment
Preserve Nession's consistent App/Web experience and precise UI geometry; no unreviewed visual behavior changes.
